'''Trade Route X143''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] regularly sent patrols along the route to combat pirate activities.

[[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 years ABY]] a CorSec [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] recruit was attacked by three [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] while on patrol on this trade route. He managed to destroy the ships and CorSec [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rhea]] immediately ordered an attack on other Black Sun ships spotted in the system.

==Behind the scenes==
The name of this trade route is mentioned in the first mission given out by CorSec pilot trainer Sergeant [[Rhea]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. In this mission, the player has to fly to several waypoints in the Corellian system and then destroy three attacking Black Sun ships to complete the mission.
